devdoc.details: This contract only contains view functions that doesn't spend gas. However, some RPC           providers put a cap on the amount of gas that the transaction *would* consume to           prevent spamming. As a rough refernece, a try using a free INFURA endpoint succesfully           executes around 75k addresses for getNativeBalances but fails when requesting 100k.           It's advised to split up such big lists to prevent failures.
devdoc.title: Address Checker contract

addressStates(address[]).notice: Returns an array of structs with both the native token balance and whether the addresses have bytecode          deployed for for an array of addresses.

contractsDeployed(address[]).notice: Returns an array of booleans signaling whether there is bytecode deployed for an array of addresses.

nativeBalances(address[]).notice: Returns an array of the native token balances for array of addresses.

queryPriceFeeds(address[]).notice: Returns the price feed data for an array of addresses.

userdoc.notice: Gets data from multiple addresses in single function calls.           It can be used to check balances and to check whether there is bytecode           (contract deployed) for multiple addresses. This is useful in order to avoid           issuing a separate call for each address, which is very innefficient.           It is also used to query all price feed data for multiple assets in a single call.
